title: Low Volume in Forex
signal: average daily volume over the past 21 days
reason: lower liquidity in forex pairs with low volume leads to higher transaction costs and reduced tradability, resulting in lower returns for long positions

title: Forex Volatility-Scaled Trend Following
signal: Compute 20-day realized volatility of the currency pair. Use inverse volatility as a scaling factor for the trend-following position size (higher scaling for lower volatility).
reason: During low-volatility periods, trends are more likely to persist, allowing larger positions with lower risk.
